scope: Build-only helper cache; no app runtime or audio behavior change

selected compiler/toolchain tree including resolved symlinks
build recipe, flags and sanitized compiler environment policy

observed_mac_checks.note: Wall-clock observations on a busy host, not a controlled performance benchmark; fresh run includes Rust dependency compilation. Warm run forces both build scripts to rerun.

includes: warm reuse and unchanged staging inode/mtime
source/vendor/SDK/compiler content and target/flag key changes

tests.frontend_full_suite: Not rerun: only About version changed; prior .54 suite remains separate evidence

limits: Real build qualified on arm64 Mac only; fixture tests cover architecture rejection. Cross-target builds are staged separately but not physically compiled here.
Full input hashing still costs I/O; source and toolchain must remain stable during builds.
Two output copies are individually atomic, not a filesystem transaction.
Killing a process during output copying may leave an unpublished .helper-stage-* directory in that output directory.
No helper execution, audio hardware, microphone, live bundle build/signing/install, native runtime or Apple upload qualification.
Prior .54 frontend/UI-DSP and .56 MockRuntime IPC results remain separate prior evidence.
